title: Linting checks the contract against explicit rules

rows:
spectral:oas, a versioned server
path and bans on write methods

without the read-only verb bans
For the payment API with POST

elements.text: The full-crud name permits writes; it does not require every CRUD operation.
The scaffold validate:openapi command runs both profiles, so a write-enabled API needs a deliberate profile choice.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Verified against the actual Spectral YAML and npm scripts. read-only extends base.yaml and prohibits POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. full-crud extends the same base and adds no rules. base.yaml extends spectral:oas and checks server URLs against ^/v\d+$, for example /v1. The README wording calling full-crud stricter is not used here because the implementation is authoritative. These are configured rules, not proof of the full style guide or runtime security. No Spectral execution result is claimed.
